name: Deuce
source:
A slacker, somewhat brash, but a skilled pilot (maybe). Deuce flies on various missions for Oracle, often doing the dirty work. Deuce was born on a space colony, but after a Federation dispute, he was relocated to live with Tessa's parents aboard a research station. After the research lab exploded, Deuce, [url=/c745]Tessa[/url] and [url=/c747]Swig[/url] relocated to the Mothership, where they have lived ever since. Deuce pilots the Skyfish, a nimble fighter craft.

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
